_about: Photograph slots. `npm run images` downloads (hosts: unsplash.com, images.unsplash.com, commons.wikimedia.org, upload.wikimedia.org) each source once, converts it to WebP in several widths with ffmpeg and stores it under src/assets/img/, so visitors never load anything from a third party. Every photograph keeps its photographer, licence and source page; the footer prints them. These are library photographs (Unsplash License or Wikimedia Commons), chosen from the vetted taste-skill library by subject. Replace any slot with ConsultAxis's own photography by dropping a file and updating `download`. Licence check before launch: CC BY / CC BY-SA require the credit line, Unsplash and CC0 do not but we credit anyway.
